name: Resource Bar
description:
System resource monitor for the top bar, inspired by Noctalia Shell's sysmon widget.

Each metric shows an icon, a pill gauge or a history graph and its value, and tints toward an alert color as it crosses activity and critical thresholds: CPU (usage, per core, temperature, frequency), memory, swap, disks (space used and activity, any mounted disk), network and GPU (NVIDIA via nvidia-smi, AMD via sysfs).

The menu shows cards with history graphs for CPU, memory, network, GPU and every disk. Smooth animations, per-resource graph colors and everything else is configurable in the preferences.
